comments.content:
This job will let us add another job: Laser Researcher, researcher of
lasers and things involving LASERS.

Their lab will consist of a machine that is a laser. With adjustable
output. Dangerously adjustable, the only limiting factor being
engineering's bitching that the station is losing power. At a high enough
voltage it should be able to go through a wall. :science:

Perhaps the beam could even be modified by pushing a button so that it
drags things towards it, possibly at deadly speed?

Some ideas for a laser researcher could come from the Log Computer, which is already 
in the game.  I'll post some here.

Amplifier: This increases the intensity of a laser.
Class 11 Laser: This creates a very slow laser that is capable of penetrating most 
objects.
Mirror: this can reflect LOW power lasers. HIGH power goes through it!
Targetting Prism: This focuses a laser coming from any direction forward.
this is a pretty terrible idea

I don't like this idea at all, sorry. Maybe add more electronics to research lab, but
laser is too much at least for the near future.

And having a specifically 'laser research' job I wouldn't do at all.
